regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your kind favor of several months ago - duly rec'd and notes. Please pardon delayed acknowlegement .. I surely sympathize with your little one who has eczema. I do not know how it came that only To-day I got to read your letter. To sponge with diluted creclin is good for eczema. - say . a teaspoonful or more in a pint of water. Enrollment in the Seraphic Mass Assoc'n too has brought wonder results. ..
